craft_notes: Sthāyin: Love pleading through dread (rati under fear). Em-dash→comma (proving softens onto ranking). Rejected: 'if' for 'as' conditional — kept as. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: As thou, e'en thou, shouldst prove beyond, O Becoming,
whose self-ranked onset and offset triple the world.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhavān iva bhavān eva bhaved yadi paraṃ bhava svaśaktivyūhasaṃvyūḍhatrailokyārambhasaṃhṛtiḥ

reads_against.argmap: As you, indeed you would be, if supreme — O Bhava. → If supreme, you are arrayed beginning-dissolution by own power.
c1_essence: As you, indeed you, in the beyond: power-hosts launch and close triple worlds.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śṛṅgāra-bhakti with karuṇā (love pleading through dread)

l2.plain_english: Were you as you are, O Becoming, in the beyond — your hosts of power marshalled to launch and close the triple world.
l2.sanskrit_cite: bhavān iva bhavān eva bhaved yadi paraṃ bhava svaśaktivyūhasaṃvyūḍhatrailokyārambhasaṃhṛtiḥ
